selection.summary: Implemented the "Reverse links to topics" (backlinks) feature for NodeBB core against base commit f24b630e1afcb8135144be66d67a09a61b21753e. Changes: (1) src/posts/index.js (h2) — added Posts.syncBacklinks(), gated on new meta.config.enableBacklinks setting; it scans post content for /topic/<tid> hrefs (excluding self-references), validates referenced topics via topics.getTopicsFields, records backlink sorted sets (`pid:<pid>:backlinks`, `topic:<tid>:backlinks`), and logs a localized `backlink` topic event with href to the referencing post. (2) src/posts/create.js (h6) — calls Posts.syncBacklinks after action:post.save. (3) src/posts/edit.js (h3) — calls Posts.syncBacklinks after post edit/parse. (4) src/topics/events.js (h1, h14, h16, h30) — registered new `backlink` event type (fa-link icon, `[[topic:backlinks]]` text) via the existing Events._types map rendered in the topic timeline. (5) src/views/admin/settings/post.tpl (h5, h17) — new ACP settings row with enableBacklinks checkbox. (6) Localization: added `backlinks` ("Referenced by") to public/language/en-GB/topic.json (h0, h18) and `backlinks`/`backlinks.enable` keys to public/language/en-GB/admin/settings/post.json (h4, h12). No runtime tests were run, so this is an unverified source patch.

native_export.selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles plus at most one presented, provenance-valid adjacent test read for a selected same-stem implementation source; native source projection and export unchanged.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
